verdicts.reason: Both turn the card into a full-height panel that hides the city skyline, leaving only a thin strip at the bottom. Both also move the 'OBSIDIAN ONE' eyebrow below the body copy, which breaks the reading order, and both use an oversized CTA. In A, the logo is tiny, low-contrast and right-aligned, so it doesn't line up with the left-aligned headline, and there is a large dead gap between the headphones and the CTA. B keeps the logo legible and left-aligned with the copy and has tighter vertical rhythm. Its weakness is that the headline and body sit almost against the left edge (about 6px margin).
